answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 7 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 56 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. What carries the copper here is verification, the comet of cost is what stops the farm, and the horizon of the record keeps every claim checkable.
